# A change that means to delete a test file (any *_test.go) or a list under
# internal/ci/testdata declares it here, one `<path> <why>` row, in the SAME
# change (internal/ci/classtests_class_test.go, the classtests rule). The rule
# reads the declaration out of git, not out of the tree: only a row this merge
# ADDS declares a deletion this merge makes, so a stale tree's old rows declare
# nothing, and a squash from a stale base that drops a file dev had is red.
# 2026-09-26: #4346 was that squash; it deleted the silent class test, its
# allowlist and two of its controls with every check green. Rows are a log and
# may be trimmed once old; trimming weakens nothing.
internal/ci/testdata/class-tests.txt the tree-resident list of class tests went with the tree a stale-base squash overwrites (#4381's guard); the classtests rule now reads the merge's deletions out of git
